name: Nadiral-Tempest
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, a binary sunset emerge like the bones of the planet.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Nothing about the gravity well anomaly appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
For traders, titanium and rare flora alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
